data.body: F01 conformance correction followed a second RED and GREEN cycle. The relocated catalog retained every file entry, regeneration command, enforcement gate, and section order. The former headings and three parity descriptions contained prohibited connectors, and the CLI row contained a clause-joining colon. The focused suite failed four catalog tests after the compliant headings were specified, then passed all 22 after the catalog changed. This intentionally declines the plan-review heading-preservation advisory because the operator punctuation standard governs new maintained text. The historical adoption narrative now resides in ticket forworn-zanyish-narwhale instead of the current-state catalog.
